introHtml: Hand wash only reusable straws are designed for durability and care, making them ideal for businesses that want to offer a premium, long-lasting promotional item. Unlike dishwasher-safe options, these straws often feature delicate materials like glass or coated metal that require gentle handling. Perfect for coffee shops, corporate gifts, or eco-conscious events, they encourage recipients to take their time with a quality product. Customize with your logo through screen printing or etching for a refined look that stands out.
